title: Container granted the NET_ADMIN capability in yaml — review required
description: cap_add with NET_ADMIN lets the container change interfaces, routes, firewall rules and traffic control on the host network namespace. It is the capability most often used to build a tunnel or intercept traffic from a compromised pod. The rule flags the grant; whether the workload genuinely manages networking is a review decision.
remediation: Remove NET_ADMIN, or run the network tooling in a dedicated namespace with a documented justification.
limitation: Lexical: matches NET_ADMIN in a cap_add list; capabilities granted through a securityContext in another file are out of scope.
